Definition: a noble, i.e. liberal, opulent; also (as noun in the derived sense) a halloo
BiblicalUsage: Shoa means noble and liberal, the man who gives freely, and it also means a cry, a halloo. Isaiah says the vile person shall no more be called liberal, Job says God accepts not the persons of princes nor regards the rich more than the poor, and in the valley of vision the word is a crying to the mountains.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe true liberality is a character, not a title, and God has never been fooled by the label Isaiah says will one day be stripped away.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
